tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background behind everything. Never put the roster grid directly on it: the grid sits on `sheet`.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The roster sheet, cards, inputs, dialogs. The "paper on the wall".

tokens.name: sheet-sunk
tokens.usage: Weekend columns and table headers on the roster sheet, like the shaded Sa/So columns on a printed plan. Also hover on rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and primary icons on `paper`, `sheet`, `sheet-sunk` and every `*-wash` (≥ 11:1 light, ≥ 11:1 dark). Fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, day-of-week labels, wish-missed ring, on `paper`, `sheet`, `sheet-sunk` (≥ 5.9:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines of the roster grid and dividers. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, gap cells. ≥ 3:1 on `sheet` and `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Ballpoint blue: links, selected state, today-column marker, focus ring. A human action, never a fill for primary buttons. Text ≥ 4.5:1 on `sheet`/`paper`.

tokens.name: action-wash
tokens.usage: Selected row/cell background, selected segment.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an `action` fill (selected segment).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the surface colour. ≥ 3:1 on `paper`, `sheet`, `sheet-sunk`, `action-wash`. The 2px offset is mandatory: it keeps the ring off `ink` buttons, where it would drop below 3:1.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Graphite: AI suggestions. Dashed borders and the "Vorschlag / Suggestion" label. Text ≥ 4.5:1 on `sheet` and `pencil-wash`.

tokens.name: pencil-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a suggestion card or a pencilled grid cell.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Red pen. Rule violations only: the ring around a violating cell, the "!" mark, the violation message icon. Text ≥ 4.5:1 on `sheet` and `alert-wash`.

tokens.name: alert-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a rule-violation message.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an `alert` fill (the "!" badge).

tokens.name: shift-frueh
tokens.usage: Frühdienst / Early (F / E). Sunrise amber. Solid fill of the shift chip, legend swatch and the marker underline in grid cells.

tokens.name: on-shift-frueh
tokens.usage: Letter on a `shift-frueh` chip.

tokens.name: shift-frueh-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash: background of a frueh cell in the roster grid.

tokens.name: shift-frueh-ink
tokens.usage: Letter in a frueh grid cell, on `shift-frueh-wash` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: shift-spaet
tokens.usage: Spätdienst / Late (S / L). Dusk violet. Solid fill of the shift chip, legend swatch and the marker underline in grid cells.

tokens.name: on-shift-spaet
tokens.usage: Letter on a `shift-spaet` chip.

tokens.name: shift-spaet-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash: background of a spaet cell in the roster grid.

tokens.name: shift-spaet-ink
tokens.usage: Letter in a spaet grid cell, on `shift-spaet-wash` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: shift-nacht
tokens.usage: Nachtdienst / Night (N / N). Deep navy, the darkest chip in both themes. Solid fill of the shift chip, legend swatch and the marker underline in grid cells.

tokens.name: on-shift-nacht
tokens.usage: Letter on a `shift-nacht` chip.

tokens.name: shift-nacht-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash: background of a nacht cell in the roster grid.

tokens.name: shift-nacht-ink
tokens.usage: Letter in a nacht grid cell, on `shift-nacht-wash` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: shift-bereitschaft
tokens.usage: Bereitschaftsdienst / On-call (B / O). Clinic green (was teal; moved for colour-blind separation from grey leave). Solid fill of the shift chip, legend swatch and the marker underline in grid cells.

tokens.name: on-shift-bereitschaft
tokens.usage: Letter on a `shift-bereitschaft` chip.

tokens.name: shift-bereitschaft-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash: background of a bereitschaft cell in the roster grid.

tokens.name: shift-bereitschaft-ink
tokens.usage: Letter in a bereitschaft grid cell, on `shift-bereitschaft-wash` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: shift-frei
tokens.usage: Urlaub, frei / Leave (U / V). Grey, always with 45° hatching. Solid fill of the shift chip, legend swatch and the marker underline in grid cells.

tokens.name: on-shift-frei
tokens.usage: Letter on a `shift-frei` chip.

tokens.name: shift-frei-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash: background of a frei cell in the roster grid.

tokens.name: shift-frei-ink
tokens.usage: Letter in a frei grid cell, on `shift-frei-wash` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: shift-nacht-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of the night chip. Needed in dark, where navy would vanish into `sheet`; ≥ 3:1 on `sheet`.

tokens.name: env
tokens.usage: Environment badge text and border: "Demo-Umgebung, synthetische Daten". Ochre, deliberately unlike any shift.

tokens.name: env-wash
tokens.usage: Environment badge background.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per dashboard page: the page title (W1–W13). Not on mobile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Mobile screen titles; dialog titles; the status line at the top of a screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Abdeckbar, wenn Sie ein Wochenende im Juni abgeben.
styles.usage: All running text. 16px is the floor for body copy on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chip labels, table headers, compact buttons on the dashboard.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, helper text, timestamps, the environment badge. Smallest running text allowed.

styles.name: num-figure
styles.usage: Big metrics: wishes granted, overtime hours, fairness deltas. Always tabular (class adds tnum).

styles.name: num-time
styles.usage: Shift times, deadlines ("Antwort bis 06:57"), hours in tables. Tabular so columns of times align.

styles.name: num-small
styles.usage: Day numbers and weekdays in the roster header, hour totals in the grid's last column. Tabular.

styles.name: grid-letter
styles.usage: The shift letter inside a roster cell. Heavy so it reads at arm's length on a wall screen.

styles.name: grid-name
styles.usage: Physician names in the grid's row headers.

spacing.note: 4px base. The roster grid has its own fixed cell sizes under `size`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's letter and its label; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip padding; inside table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of compact buttons and inputs (horizontal); list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter; card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs and the suggestion card on desktop; gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a dashboard page to the first section; empty-state padding.

radius.note: Radius follows hierarchy: paper is square, small marks are barely softened, things you press are soft, things that float are softest.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The roster sheet, grid cells, tables. Square like the printed Dienstplan.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Shift chips, the environment badge, status tags. Small marks on paper.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, checkboxes (4px is fine for 20px checkboxes: use radius-mark).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floating things only: dialogs, popovers, mobile bottom sheets, toasts, the suggestion card.

shadow.note: Only things that leave the paper get a shadow. Everything in-page is separated by `rule` hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The roster sheet on `paper`: barely lifted, like a pinned page.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, a cell being dragged, the Warum?/Why? popover.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs (W5 approval) and mobile bottom sheets. Pair with a scrim.

size.note: Fixed sizes for the grid and touch targets.

tokens.name: cell-w
tokens.usage: Width of a day column in the roster grid (dashboard). 31 days + names fit 1440px.

tokens.name: cell-h
tokens.usage: Height of a physician row in the roster grid.

tokens.name: rowhead-w
tokens.usage: Width of the physician name column.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile; primary mobile buttons are this tall.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on the dashboard.
